playbooks.name: Arrest & Detention Response
playbooks.description: Immediate actions and coordination steps when a team member or contact is arrested or detained

checklists.title: Immediate Response (First 1 Hour)
items: Confirm detention: Who, where, when, which authority
Contact emergency legal aid or human rights organization
Notify designated emergency contact (if safe to do so)
Enable dead man's switch for the detained person
Secure the detained person's digital footprint (change their passwords if you have access)
Document the arrest: location, time, badge numbers, vehicle details

checklists.title: Legal Support (Hours 1-24)
items: Find and contact a lawyer who handles political/sensitive cases
Prepare habeas corpus or similar legal filing
Document any charges or lack thereof
Contact relevant consulates if foreign national
Inform relevant human rights organizations
Prepare public statement (coordinate with legal counsel first)

checklists.title: Team Coordination
items: Activate secure communication channel for detention response team
Assign point person for family liaison
Assign point person for media/public communication
Assign point person for legal coordination
Document all actions in ops journal
Review duress decoy mode for other at-risk team members

checklists.title: Evidence & Documentation
items: Create evidence room entry for arrest event
Collect witness statements from those present
Secure photo/video evidence of arrest (if available and safe)
Create timeline of events leading to arrest
Document any injuries or medical needs
Create witness ledger entry with signed statements

playbooks.name: Internet Shutdown Response
playbooks.description: Operate and coordinate during internet or communications blackout

checklists.title: Immediate Response
items: Switch to offline mode: disconnect network, use local data only
Activate offline briefcase if previously cached
Verify you have critical maps and data downloaded
Switch to mesh networking for peer-to-peer communication
Use relay/blueprints for information sharing via offline channels
Set up local Wi-Fi hotspot for nearby coordination if safe

checklists.title: Information Gathering (Offline)
items: Monitor local radio/TV for official announcements
Use in-person networks to verify information
Document all observations with timestamps (for later verification)
Map offline: note checkpoints, closures, incidents
Coordinate with neighbors for neighborhood watch
Use printed field manuals and protocols

checklists.title: Coordination Without Network
items: Use QR codes to share information in person
Leave relay messages at trusted dead drops
Use USB/sneakernet for data transfer between trusted parties
Meet in person at predetermined safe locations
Use face-to-face verification of information
Plan for network restoration: what to verify first

checklists.title: When Network Returns
items: Verify official narratives against offline documentation
Upload witness statements and evidence collected during blackout
Check for messages missed in offline mail/mesh store
Update maps with incidents observed during blackout
Share verified information with broader network
Document shutdown duration and impacts

checklists.title: Immediate Safety (0-2 Hours)
items: MOVE if in immediate danger: personal safety first
Grab go-bag: documents, cash, phone, charger, medications
Signal trusted contacts you're safe (if possible)
Note your route and destination for later documentation
Mark your location on map before moving (if safe)
Help neighbors who need assistance (elderly, disabled, children)

checklists.title: Establish Coordination Hub
items: Set up temporary coordination point at safe location
Use Trail for posting needs and offers
Coordinate with local aid organizations if present
Document displacement: households, routes, destinations
Map safe corridors and danger areas to avoid
Establish communication plan without network if needed

checklists.title: Resource Allocation
items: Use Allocator to plan resource distribution
Prioritize: medical needs, children, elderly, disabled
Track inventory: food, water, shelter, medical supplies
Coordinate mutual aid via Trail matching
Document all allocations for transparency
Plan for duration: this may be prolonged

checklists.title: Documentation & Evidence
items: Document causes of displacement (if safe to observe)
Record human rights violations observed
Create evidence room entries for destruction/property loss
Document responsible parties (badges, units, vehicles)
Collect witness statements from other displaced persons
Prepare for future accountability: timestamp everything

playbooks.name: Medical Crisis Response
playbooks.description: Coordinate healthcare access during medical system collapse or attack

checklists.title: Immediate Medical Response
items: Assess: life-threatening conditions first
Apply first aid for life-threatening injuries
Document symptoms and conditions for professional care
Note time of injury/illness onset
Preserve evidence of injuries (if caused by violence)
Do not move seriously injured persons unless necessary

checklists.title: Healthcare Access
items: Identify functioning medical facilities
Map ambulance routes if operating
Use medical shortage board to find available resources
Coordinate with informal medical networks if hospitals compromised
Document barriers to medical access
Arrange medical transport if needed

checklists.title: Medical Documentation
items: Document all medical care provided and received
Record names of medical personnel (if safe)
Photograph injuries with timestamp for evidence
Document any denial of medical care
Track medication shortages and access issues
Create medical evidence room entries for conflict-related injuries

checklists.title: Follow-up & Long-term Care
items: Plan for ongoing treatment needs
Coordinate follow-up care through Trail if needed
Document long-term impacts for advocacy
Connect with psychological support if available
Document medical infrastructure damage for accountability
Share medical data with relevant health organizations (safely)

playbooks.name: Surveillance Detection Response
playbooks.description: Detect, evade, and respond to surveillance and monitoring

checklists.title: Detection Indicators
items: Note: repeated sightings of same person/vehicle
Document: unusual interest in your work or contacts
Monitor: equipment interference (phone, computer)
Watch for: break-ins or theft of devices (not valuables)
Check: physical tampering with locks, windows, vehicle
Track: online account anomalies or password resets

checklists.title: Immediate Response
items: ASSUME worst case: you may be monitored
Stop sensitive communications until verified clear
Switch to secure, offline communication methods
Alert trusted contacts to be cautious
Enable duress decoy mode if identity/keys at risk
Do not confront or acknowledge surveillance

checklists.title: Operational Security
items: Review and update threat model
Change meeting locations and routines
Use mesh networking instead of centralized comms
Sweep living/working space for listening devices (if safe)
Verify identity of all contacts before sharing sensitive info
Minimize digital footprint where possible

checklists.title: Documentation
items: Document surveillance incidents with timestamps
Create evidence room entries for each incident
Record details: persons, vehicles, locations, times
Photograph evidence (if safe to do so)
Share information with security support network
Update risk assessment for team operations

playbooks.name: Violent Crackdown Response
playbooks.description: Response to state violence, protest suppression, and mass arrests

checklists.title: Immediate Safety
items: PERSONAL SAFETY FIRST: leave danger zone if possible
Help others evacuate if you can do so safely
Find cover: stay away from windows and street level
Document location and time for later verification
Do not draw attention to yourself if unsafe
Have escape route planned before engagement

checklists.title: Documentation (If Safe)
items: Document violations with timestamps and locations
Record badge numbers, vehicle IDs, unit markings
Photograph injuries and property damage
Collect witness contact information for follow-up
Note use of specific weapons or excessive force
Create evidence room entries for each incident

checklists.title: Coordination & Support
items: Coordinate medical care for injured
Set up notification system for arrests (check-in network)
Use Trail to coordinate safe houses and support
Map danger zones and safe corridors
Coordinate legal response for detained persons
Share verified information with media/organizations

checklists.title: Accountability & Follow-up
items: Create witness ledger entries with signed statements
Compile evidence into verified incident reports
Share evidence with human rights organizations
Create timeline of events for accountability
Document responsible units and individuals
Prepare for potential legal action or advocacy

playbooks.name: Document & Evidence Emergency
playbooks.description: Urgent document protection and evidence preservation under threat

checklists.title: Immediate Document Protection
items: IDENTIFY critical documents: evidence, sources, research data
Create evidence room entries for all critical items
Generate SHA-256 hashes for verification
Create VFXPACK1 bundles for export and backup
Upload to secure, distributed storage if possible
Destroy local copies if search/raid imminent (after secure backup)

checklists.title: Source Protection
items: Protect source identities: encrypt or destroy identifying info
Use duress decoy mode to show fake document set if compelled
Enable dead man's switch for sensitive source information
Document what was destroyed and why for later reconstruction
Have verified testimony already if sources at risk
Clear browsing history and communication logs

checklists.title: Verification Preparation
items: Create witness ledger entries for document authenticity
Document provenance: where, when, how obtained
Prepare verification packets for key documents
Create timestamped evidence chains for all critical items
Have verification keys ready for media/organizations
Document chain of custody thoroughly

checklists.title: Contingency Planning
items: Identify trusted recipients for emergency document release
Prepare Guardian release packets for worst-case scenario
Set up dead drops (digital or physical) for document recovery
Coordinate with trusted contacts for distributed storage
Have denial/release strategy prepared
Test that backup verification keys work
